name: kicad-collab-web
description: React + TypeScript chrome for the KiCad Collaborative web editor (bundled into static/dist/ui.js)

scripts.build: npm run build:canvas && npm run build:editor && esbuild web/main.tsx --bundle --minify --sourcemap --target=es2020 --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --outfile=static/dist/ui.js --legal-comments=none && tailwindcss -i web/styles/tailwind.css -o static/dist/ui.css --minify
scripts.dev: esbuild web/canvas/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --sourcemap --outfile=static/kicad-canvas.js --watch & esbuild web/main.tsx --bundle --sourcemap --target=es2020 --jsx=automatic --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"development\" --outfile=static/dist/ui.js --watch & tailwindcss -i web/styles/tailwind.css -o static/dist/ui.css --watch & wait
scripts.test: cd static && for t in render sch-tools pcb-tools props dialogs; do node tests/$t.test.js || exit 1; done
scripts.build:canvas: esbuild web/canvas/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --sourcemap --outfile=static/kicad-canvas.js --legal-comments=none --banner:js="// GENERATED by 'npm run build:canvas' from web/canvas/*.ts — edit the modules, not this file."
scripts.build:editor: esbuild web/editor/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --minify --sourcemap --outfile=static/dist/editor.js --legal-comments=none --banner:js="// GENERATED by 'npm run build:editor' from web/editor/*.ts — edit the modules, not this file."
